public function statement_line(order: Invoice) returns Text
  purpose: One row of the statement: customer, number of lines and total, in fixed columns.
  example: statement_line(Invoice(customer: "ACME", lines: [], discount_percent: 0))
    is "ACME          0 lines      0.00"

  let line_count be order.lines.length()
  let line_label be if line_count is 1 then "line" otherwise "lines" end
  let total_text be invoice.total(order).rounded(2).to_text()
  return "{order.customer.pad_right(14)}{line_count} {line_label.pad_right(10)}{total_text.pad_left(6)}"
end
```
